title: Finite typed metadata, feature preparation, validated filters and owned planar geometries

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name inventory only; no complete parameter, numerical or project migration compatibility percentage

implementation.metadata: Typed nullable Number/String/StaticArray reads over finite inline Elements and actual per-image metadata frames. Keep concrete joined Image/array IR and detached nested outputs. Default toDictionary excludes system keys; explicit missing keys omitted by local policy.
implementation.feature_identity: Use actual supplied id/system:index only. Selection and property replacement preserve the local destination identity separately when dropping index, reject conflicting indices. Image source=null clears ordinary properties but retains actual system:index and disables inherited properties. No Google identity claim.
implementation.selection: Actual bounded RE2 compilation for every selector. Proven plain ASCII literal names use charged exact dictionary lookup; other patterns reserve complete subject scans. Ordered unique output names, optional null geometry and finite ordered numeric arrays.
implementation.filters: Nine comparison aliases plus real string prefixes/suffixes, inclusive range, UTC dayOfYear, constants and hasGeometry. Validate every inline branch before rows, including empty input. Actual geometry retained in sampled/classified runtime views.
implementation.runtime_table_filter_boundary: Aliases, range, constants, string boundaries and hasGeometry admit after canonical lowering; dayOfYear/calendarRange and hasType reject in sampled/classified tables. Original16 operations/64 predicate nodes/16 depth/50000 work retained.
implementation.empty_map: Validate serialized operator names and new keyword contracts without evaluate(), catalog access or invented rows. Missing-property and data-dependent types cannot be checked on an empty input.
implementation.geometry: Owned normalized finite EPSG:4326 planar GeometryValue with accepted constructor-option sidecar. Precharge decode/copy before GEOS. Revalidate mutable contents instead of trusting a historical boolean. Explicit adapters retain compatibility at public JSON/table/static-value boundaries.
implementation.constructors: BBox follows pinned-client longitude normalization/full-world and pole clamping, rejects dateline-wrapped or inverted latitude extents; MultiGeometry retains collection children and LinearRing its own type. Explicit spherical/projected/left-inside/maxError contexts reject.
